name: Incline machine press
instructions: Set the seat so the handles line up with your upper chest.
Sit back against the pad and grip the handles.
Press the handles up and forward until your arms are almost straight.
Bring the handles back slowly until you feel a stretch in your chest.
cue: Press up and out, back down slowly
mistakes: Setting the seat too low, so the shoulders do the work.
Lifting your back off the pad to push harder.
